name: Mirae Asset Vision Special Purpose Acquisition 4 Co.
summary: Mirae Asset Vision Special Purpose Acquisition 4 Co. functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), specifically formed to execute a business combination, such as a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, or reorganization, with one or more target companies. This entity was established on February 19, 2024, and its headquarters are located in Seoul, South Korea.
